name: Build Idea Graph
what: Decompose approved intent into small idea nodes connected by prerequisite edges.
why: A graph preserves the project structure and lets the user inspect one decision without losing the whole.
expected_result: Acyclic, clickable project graph whose nodes expose all eight idea sections.

implementation.how: Store one JSON file per node, validate dependencies, derive reverse edges, and render self-contained HTML.
implementation.why_this_way: Per-node JSON is deterministic, dependency-free, merge-friendly, and keeps edges in one source of truth.

local_findings: The repository already contains HTML DAG rendering ideas, but this plugin stays isolated from its ECL model.
external_findings: https://github.github.com/spec-kit/ separates specification, planning, tasks, and implementation.
research.reuse_decision: Reuse the staged artifact pattern; implement the graph renderer with browser-native HTML, CSS, and SVG.

weekly_plan.outcome: Validated schema and user-approved name-only decomposition graph.
Researched node details and a clickable self-contained HTML review surface.

verification.plan: Render a graph, click each node, and verify eight sections plus prerequisites and dependents are visible.

future_use: Planning, implementation, debugging, and onboarding all share the same graph contract.
